name: Premium 12' Teardrop Flags
descriptionHtml:
Download Design : .Download Instruction.


 12' Single-Sided

12' Double-Sided

Graphic Size:124'' height x 37'' width

Total Height with Pole :12ft

Feature:
Due to its feather-like shape, called a feather flag
Available in white fabric only
Your artwork will be dye sublimated on super poly knit fabric
Flag is reinforced with fiber glass pole pockets to create a stylish black outline around the edge of the flag
Fiber glass poles are strong and flexible
Polished aluminum collar pole segment ends and ergonomic
Cross base is great for use on hard, flat surfaces both indoors and out
Imprint Method: Full-Color Dye Sublimation

Wind Speed Rating: 18-23 mph




Materials
Carry Case: 600 Denier Polyester
Graphic/Flag: 110g Knitted polyster
Hardware: 100% epoxy fiberglass with lifetime warranty

  • 24-Hour Quick Ship program requirements: Quick Ship item numbers must be used when placing orders for this program. Complete purchase order, payment, and production-ready artwork must be received by 5:00 p.m. Central. Order must be placed online via website. Proofs not available. Accuracy of the artwork is the customer's responsibility. Order drop-ships from factory within two business days via UPS or FedEx only. Established credit terms or credit card payment due at time of order placement. Quick Ship program items cannot be combined with regular lead time items on a purchase order. Factory will not be held responsible for any delays in the shipment due to discrepancies with the artwork and/or purchase order. Artwork setup charge included in price. Maximum quantity per day is 5. Program is subject to availability.

Warranty

  • Lifetime hardware warranty - Standard warranty is a parts and labor warranty which warrants product against defects in material and workmanship. It does not cover damage due to accidents, abuse or normal wear and tear. Products found to be defective will be replaced or repaired at factory's discretion.
  • 90 day graphic warranty with outdoor use - Outdoor usage is limited to a 90 day standard parts and labor warranty which warrants product against defects in material and workmanship. It does not cover damage due to accidents, abuse, or normal wear and tear. Products found to be defective will be replaced or repaired at factory's discretion.
  • 1 year graphic warranty on indoor use - Indoor use is a 1 year standard parts and labor warranty which warrants product against defects in material and workmanship. It does not cover damage due to accidents, abuse, or normal wear and tear. Products found to be defective will be replaced or repaired at factory's discretion.

howToOrderHtml:
3 Easy Steps

Step 1: Shop 🛒

Pick your products and add-ons, then add your order to the cart.

Step 2: Payment 💳

Go to your cart and choose your payment option:

Full payment: your design gets priority 🚀

Deposit: start the design now and pay the remaining balance after artwork approval

(Deposit option applies only to orders over $295 USD. Orders below this amount require full payment.)

Step 3: Artwork 🎨

Complete checkout and upload your artwork using the provided link.

Don’t see it? No worries — we’ll email it to you.
